# Radoslav Radev Says He Has More Than 500 Students In One Year And A Half And Will Not Forget Their Support Before His Competitions

Radoslav Radev says that they have more than 500 students over a year and a half, and that he will not forget the viewers' support before his competitions. [src: vid-Hm0lo9StzFI @ 02:00] [src: vid-Hm0lo9StzFI @ 02:26]

## Details

- He says that they have more than 500 students over a year and a half. [src: vid-Hm0lo9StzFI @ 02:00]
- He says he is really grateful to every one of the viewers. [src: vid-Hm0lo9StzFI @ 02:14]
- He says he will not forget the support and the motivation that the viewers gave him in all the years before all of his competitions. [src: vid-Hm0lo9StzFI @ 02:26]

## Evidence

- vid-Hm0lo9StzFI @ 02:00 (Radoslav Radev): "year and a half we have more than 500 students"
- vid-Hm0lo9StzFI @ 02:14 (Radoslav Radev): "and that's for one year and a half and i'm really grateful to every one of you guys honestly"
- vid-Hm0lo9StzFI @ 02:26 (Radoslav Radev): "the support the motivation that you're giving me you know i'm athlete from a lot of years and the motivation and the support that you gave me in all the years before all of my competitions i will not forget about these things"
